name: AQG Studio
description: A full-stack assessment platform that turns PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and text documents into grounded quizzes. A Next.js and TypeScript frontend pairs with a FastAPI backend and LangGraph multi-agent pipeline for document parsing, pgvector-backed RAG, quality checks, human review, and exports to Moodle XML, QTI, PDF, DOCX, JSON, and CSV. Model access routes through OpenRouter with NVIDIA NIM fallback.
summary: Documents in, grounded quizzes out. A full-stack assessment platform with a LangGraph pipeline, retrieval, quality checks, human review, and exports to learning platforms.

name: JARVIS Windows Local
description: A Windows-first desktop assistant built with PySide6. It combines local Ollama reasoning, faster-whisper transcription, SQLite memory, wake-word voice control, policy-gated actions, and a scoped Claude Code handoff. Windows builds use PyInstaller and Inno Setup.
summary: A Windows desktop assistant with local Ollama reasoning, voice control, transcription, SQLite memory, and policy-gated actions.

name: Personal portfolio
description: A server-first portfolio built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Anime.js powers the motion design; a static export runs on GitHub Pages.
summary: A Next.js portfolio with Anime.js motion design, exported to GitHub Pages.

name: Classifying Periodic Variable Stars
description: A Gaia DR3 photometry project that classifies RR Lyrae, Cepheids, long-period variables, and eclipsing binaries. The notebook uses Pandas and NumPy for data preparation, scikit-learn for preprocessing and evaluation, and TensorFlow/Keras sequence models, with plots from Matplotlib and Seaborn.
summary: Classifying RR Lyrae, Cepheids, long-period variables, and eclipsing binaries using Gaia DR3 photometry and sequence models.

name: Smart Driver Monitoring Dashboard
description: A Kotlin and Jetpack Compose driver-monitoring app published as downloadable Android APKs.
summary: A Kotlin and Jetpack Compose driver-monitoring app published as downloadable Android APKs.

name: Zinging
description: AI assistant with NVIDIA NIM-powered agent workflows, database-backed memory, caching, and translation, prepared for Railway deployment.
summary: AI assistant with NVIDIA NIM-powered agent workflows, database-backed memory, caching, and translation, prepared for Railway deployment.

name: Host
description: React and Vite file-hosting product for uploading, organizing, and sharing files through clean public links, with private-by-default uploads and moderation-aware access.
summary: React and Vite file-hosting product for uploading, organizing, and sharing files through clean public links, with private-by-default uploads and moderation-aware access.
